title: Zephyrine and the Horizon
author: Astrid Okafor
blurb: Rafael Crane, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
